releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.22 — a security and privacy pass. Your login tokens are now encrypted on the device with a key held by the Android Keystore instead of sitting in plain preferences, and the server got real protections: login/sign-up throttling against password guessing, an upload size limit, files that cannot be read outside the media folder, streamed downloads that no longer load whole videos into memory, and no personal e-mail baked into the admin code. Details in SECURITY.md.
